name: Crowded-long fragility fade — high funding + OI expansion + band-stretch (short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: when funding_rate is persistently high (top decile) AND open_interest is EXPANDING into that funding, longs are crowded and financing their own eventual unwind — every 8h they bleed carry and the marginal buyer is a fee-insensitive leveraged latecomer. We short (direction -1) the crowd just before funding cost thins demand (documented loop: high funding -> longs close to avoid fees -> premium collapses). bb_z stretched high confirms price is over-extended, not mid-range, so we are fading exhaustion not a fresh breakout. funding_feature accrues the positive carry to us as a short (we RECEIVE it). Hold ~0.5-1d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if it shorts into trends — in a strong bull leg funding stays pinned high for weeks while price keeps rising and a naive high-funding short is run over; the edge MUST be conditional on OI EXPANSION and die when the OI-expansion filter is dropped (else it is a losing 'short strength' trade). DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if maxDD > 25% from being early on the crowded side.
catalyst: high funding + rising open interest + stretched band z — a crowded-long book to fade short.
